Name: SubtlyLiminals Pretty Bad Actually Backgrounds for Mobile Phone
Author: SubtlyLiminal
Description:
A bunch of deep fried, eye strainy, and generally awful edits I've made turned into [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] skins.  Some of which I've actually used as phone backgrounds. [i] I need my disgusting phone background fix, John.[/i]

The download just contains images that you have to put in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone'[/url]s backgrounds folder.  After, you can change your background in-game using the customization app.

uhhhhh enjoy!
